title: Courtenay Little Theatre

services.name: Season Tickets
services.desc: Enjoy all three Courtenay Little Theatre mainstage productions for just $75-our best value of the year. Purchase your Season Ticket before October 4 to lock in your preferred seats before single tickets go on sale. Plans change? No problem. If you can’t make a performance, you can exchange your tickets for another date at no extra charge. Want to receive our free email notices about our season and other events? Sign up here for our Mail Chimp mail outs. blurb: For over 60 years, Courtenay Little Theatre has been bringing the Comox Valley together through the joy of live theatre. From performers and directors to backstage crews, set builders, costumers, and more, it takes a community of volunteers to bring a show to life.
